cues: Exclamations become exclaimed that, with the feeling named: she exclaimed with sorrow that she had lost her purse.
A wish, may you live long, becomes he prayed that I might live long.
And fixed expressions simply become verbs: good morning, she greeted him; thank you, he thanked her; yes, he replied in the affirmative.
